title: Red Hat Security Advisory: java-17-openjdk security update for RHEL 8
description: A critical security update for the java-17-openjdk packages on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 addresses multiple vulnerabilities affecting the OpenJDK 17 Java Runtime Environment and Software Development Kit. The update includes fixes for issues related to Kerberos ticket handling, StringBuilder checks, JFR events, loop handling, vector masks, JMX connections, Base64 optimizations, and TLS client connections. These vulnerabilities collectively impact the security and stability of Java applications running on affected systems.
